name: NIYOMUHOZA Jean de Dieu
bio:
NIYOMUHOZA Jean de Dieu is the founder and editor of PDFFlow, a browser-based PDF tools project. He builds and tests the tools and writes practical guides to help people complete common PDF tasks without installing unnecessary software.

PDFFlow guides are based on the tools available on the site, their supported file types, actual testing, and documented limitations. Device-specific claims are only made when they can be verified.
